entries.title: The message box hint sits in the middle of the box
entries.body: The grey hint in the empty message box, such as "type, or press/hold right ⌥ to talk", is now centered on the whole box. Before, the Add files button pushed it to the right. What you type still starts at the left, beside the button.
entries.noPicture: Recorded before notes kept pictures; a release review takes one if this becomes a highlight.
